sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMNBSSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMNBSSION (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV, 29th January, 1997]
No. S.LegisA(1)/97, dated 29‑1‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Insertion of section 5-A in Sindh Act XI of 1989

SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMNBSSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMNBSSION (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV, 29th January, 1997]
No. S.LegisA(1)/97, dated 29‑1‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Insertion of section 5‑A
in Sindh Act XI of 1989.‑‑In the Sindh Public Service
Commission Act, 1989, for section 5‑A, the following new section shall be
substituted:‑‑
"5‑A.
Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, Government may, not later than
15th February, 1997, curtail the term of office of the Chairman appointed
before the coming into force of this section."
